name: After recital 4
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council suspending the application of the rules on the appointment of an authorised representative for extended producer responsibility for batteries and waste batteries and packaging and packaging waste
part_text: Leasú (4a) Ba cheart an fhionraí a thugtar isteach leis an Rialachán seo a theorannú don cheanglas riaracháin a bhaineann le hionadaí údaraithe a cheapadh agus níor cheart di difear a dhéanamh d’aon oibleagáid eile atá ar tháirgeoirí maidir le freagracht leathnaithe táirgeora ná d’aon chuspóir comhshaoil a leagtar amach i ndlí an Aontais.
